findings.explanation: A visitor who is not signed in can read the table "posts", which has no owner column. It may be public on purpose, so the tool cannot tell.
findings.fix: If "posts" should not be public, turn on row security for it and allow reads only for the people who need them. If it is public on purpose, no change is needed.

notes: The app has fewer than 2 users in its database, so the tests that need a signed-in user could only partly run. Do not read this result as a clean one.
